name: io.github.pitwch/screenconnect-mcp-server
title: ScreenConnect
description: MCP server for ScreenConnect RESTful API Manager: read, write and gated destructive tools

environmentVariables.name: SCREENCONNECT_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: ScreenConnect instance HTTPS URL, e.g. https://your-instance.example.com (http is rejected)

environmentVariables.name: SCREENCONNECT_API_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: RESTful API Manager extension shared secret (sent as CTRLAuthHeader)

environmentVariables.name: SCREENCONNECT_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Tool mode: read (default), write or destructive

environmentVariables.name: SCREENCONNECT_ENABLE_COMMANDS
environmentVariables.description: Must be true to expose destructive tools (commands, toolbox, create_session)

environmentVariables.name: SCREENCONNECT_ALLOWED_GROUPS
environmentVariables.description: Optional comma-separated full session group paths. Leave empty unless group fields are returned by your instance
